 A fast\-growing applied AI company is expanding its engineering team to build production grade computer vision capabilities that solve complex, document heavy workflows in a major industrial market.  In this role, you will help shape the visual intelligence layer of a modern AI platform. * Ability to work independently, debug effectively, and move quickly in a build\-oriented environment.



  





**Preferred Background** 



* Experience with object detection, segmentation, or 3D perception.

* Experience with edge deployment or performance sensitive inference.
